books.title_suggestion: Music from the Star Wars Trilogy: Special Edition (John Williams), International Music Publications / Warner Bros. Publications, Piano-Vocal-Guitar
books.identification_note: The eight themes grouped by film (Star Wars; The Empire Strikes Back; Return of the Jedi) match the IMP 'Music from the Star Wars Trilogy: Special Edition' PVG folio by John Williams (mid-1990s, tied to the 1997 Special Edition re-releases). All cues are John Williams originals.

songs.title: Ewok Celebration
songs.notes: Original 1983 end-credits celebration cue ('Yub Nub'), replaced in later editions by 'Victory Celebration'.

songs.title: Victory Celebration
songs.notes: Composed for the 1997 Special Edition, replacing 'Ewok Celebration' as the finale; its presence dates this folio to the Special Edition releases.
